# Code Epsilon
## Called by:
Central Command. This alert level cannot be request, and will be called solely on discretion of Central Command personnel.
## Conditions:
Central Command has deemed that the station Command personnel are no longer capable of fulfilling their duties, or extreme circumstances have occured which necessitate a mandatory takeover.
## Captain:
The Captain is to stand down and prepare for a handover of the Nuclear Authentication Disk to Central Command personnel.
The Captain is to defer to the orders of Central Command for the duration of the alert level.
## Command:
All Command personnel are to stand down and relinquish their positions until the alert level ends. Command members are to assume the duty of standard crew for the duration of the alert level.
Command personnel are to cooperate with their associated Central Command Division personnel, or with Central Command at large in their division's absence.
## Security:
All Security personnel are to stand down, with the sole exception of continuing to combat any existing threats prior to the alert level change.
Security personnel are to defer solely to Central Security Division, or to any other Central Command personnel in their absence.
## Secure Areas:
1. Secure areas are limited to relevant departmental personnel and Central Command personnel.
2. Secure areas: Security department, EVA Storage, Tech Storage, Gravity Generator, all Engineering areas beyond the lobby, Vault, and areas requiring Command access.
## General Crew:
1. All personnel must set their suit sensors to coordinates.
2. Personnel are to defer to the orders of Central Command. Should orders not be given, personnel are to shelter in place and refrain from further complicating the situation. Failure to do so may lead to arrest for insubordination.
3. Visitors to the station are to remain inside the Bar, Library, or Dormitories.
